column1: # journal-patrol.tsv -- known journal-error signatures mapped to
# allowlisted corrective actions (2026-09-14, operator directive
# "automatically check for and address journal errors"). Consumed by
# jobs/patrol.py check "journal-errors": scans journalctl --user -b and
# journalctl -k -b, warning-and-worse, SINCE the last patrol run (epoch
# watermark in logs/journal-patrol.watermark; the first run after a
# cold start baselines -- boot history is old news, not a finding).
# Each warning+ line is matched against this table in order, first
# match wins. A line matching NO signature stays silent at warning
# level, but an err-or-worse line that nothing claims is an
# unknown-journal-error alert: unknown errors are never silenced, they
# are research demands (the bestiary grows by usage, never by guess).
# THE ACTION COLUMN IS THE SAFETY CORE. The code refuses any action
# outside {transient, restart-unit, propose, alert} (config-bug
# alert). Every action is idempotent and safe to repeat:
#   transient     count occurrences; escalate to alert once the guard
#                 threshold is crossed (guard "alert>=N"); no side effect
#   restart-unit  systemctl --user restart <unit>, either the regex's
#                 captured unit (guard "max=N units=a,b") or a pinned
#                 operator-verified unit (guard "max=N unit=NAME"),
#                 at most max=N per UTC day; over budget -> alert,
#                 never a restart loop
#   propose       NEVER executes: the alert row carries the exact
#                 recommended command (guard "cmd=...") for operator
#                 eyes
#   alert         no auto-action; alert with the captured evidence
# Seeded from lines actually observed on this host (2026-09-13 boot:
# swap-thrash page-allocation failures 18:58Z, kwin XCB BadDamage/
# BadWindow 20:26Z, kglobalaccel "not activatable" 20:59Z -- the
# wired-mouse and media-key symptoms were session-level, kernel input
# side was clean).
# Columns (tab-separated):
#   id      stable signature id (findings rows + tests reference it)
#   kind    bestiary family: kwin | unit | shortcut | journald | memory | libinput
#   regex   python re, searched against the journal MESSAGE field
#   action  one of the allowlisted actions above
#   guard   action parameters: alert>=N | max=N units=a,b | cmd=...
id
kwin-xcb-error
unit-failed
column3: ([\w@.-]+\.service): (Main process exited|Failed with result|Failed to start)
